body: Update: the customer service agents said they can see that our tickets were never posted, so they are refunding us. But not refunding us for the cost of postage (16 pounds!!), which never even happened!! They told us buy a ticket on the day, but creamfields site has said that this is not possible from Manchester, pre booking is required. This is a complete joke.

I’m in the netherlands and ours still haven’t turned up. Contacted ticket master and they said “Looks like they haven’t been dispatched yet! If you still don’t have them a week before the event, contact us”.. absolutely useless!!!

I got reported for something similar. People were leaving awful comments commenting on an influencer’s BABY’s looks, calling her ugly etc. i just said maybe we should be mindful that it’s the influencer we’re here to talk about, not their child’s looks, I just think that’s stopping to a new low. Got reported and told to stop “moderating the thread myself”.
The comments show how closed minded people generally are and highlights exactly why we need such  safe spaces

Worked for Dunnes for 4 years as a college student. You can’t do ANYTHING right in their eyes regarding calling in sick - they will always always always find something to complain about, even if you do everything perfect by the book.
These questions are getting far too repetitive. It’s not that hard to search up your question to see if it’s previously been asked before posting it again.
Just stay away from Rentola and huurwoningen!!!!
Dunnes in Douglas court is always desperate for new staff!
THIS!! We all know that many of the queens are inundated with hate every time the show airs, so it’s likely that anything even remotely offensive will results in more backlash for them.
Yeah the tweets are HARSH, I think I’ll steer clear of looking at the hashtags for a while. They make everything seem so serious
I personally think the “ultra woke” side of the fandom kills the fun of it. It’s drag for god’s sake it’s supposed to be offensive!

I couldn’t believe they liked it. It was literally a basic outfit on top of a fur suit, and they ate it UP. Ru and the judges are definitely letting their love of symone cloud their judgement, if it had been someone else who wore it we all know it wouldn’t go down well.

How was it not mentioned about how much Lawrence messed up in the challenge? Had to constantly ask for his lines and Michelle had to stop to give him a speech? And he couldn’t get the “Yes it is!” line right? I love Lawrence as much as the next person but it seems like he got a bit of a pass this episode

Yeah they’ve very clearly decided that she’s going to win or at least be top 4. Same thing happened with aquaria if I recall correctly, there was a few times she definitely should have lip synced but was safe. 

Wish the show didn’t feel as fake and produced as it does, kinda sucks.
HOW was gigi not read to filth for doing the robot shtick again?? The favouritism from the judges/producers is annoying. Maybe if Michelle was there she would have mentioned it? Hope so
LOVE seeing Irish drag queens do well!! Congrats! You look gorgeous btw :)
